offset_note: 631 up to build 665 (run 34); 630 from run 36 on, because run 35 failed in CI before it published anything; 629 from run 38 on, because run 37 was cancelled before it published anything (run 38 = build 667). Runs 41-44 were test or failed runs and published nothing public. 655 from run 45 on, so run 45 + 655 = 700 (codename Kaporet). Run 45 published 700 Kaporet. Run 49 + 654 = 703 (codename Toledot). Run 50 failed in the Windows tests that need no PyTorch before it published anything, so 653 from run 51 on: run 51 + 653 = 704 (codename Achim). Run 52 failed in the Windows tests that need no PyTorch (a bash-only test lost its skip marker) before it published anything, so 946 from run 53 on: run 53 + 946 = 999 (codename Nachon, version 1.0.0-rc, release tag v1.0.0-rc). Run 53 published 999 Nachon. The offset stays 946 from run 54 on: run 54 + 946 = 1000 (codename Chazak, version 1.0.0-rc.2, release tag v1.0.0-rc.2). Run 54 failed in the Windows tests that need no PyTorch (every test passed, then the pytest process crashed on exit) before it published anything, so 945 from run 55 on: run 55 + 945 = 1000 (codename Chazak, version 1.0.0-rc.2, release tag v1.0.0-rc.2).
